info.title: ucl - manage products, customers and license keys, and issue offline licenses.
info.description: Console tool for Umbraco package vendors: manage products, customers and license keys, and issue offline licenses with Umbraco.Community.Licensing.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Run ucl with no arguments, at a terminal, to open the menu. Answer each question at the
prompt; type /cancel at any question to cancel the action and return to the menu.
